label: Dendrochronological date of a panel
text: AR.O.A1.1.5 Dendrochronological date of a panel. A felling date is a lower bound on the painting date. It holds only if the board's outer rings survive or sapwood is estimated. The method's chronology is EA (uses EA, UNVERIFIED cell id).

warrant.standard: Instrumental and documentary evidence converge on the making
warrant.defeaters: Sample or document not from the work
